Operations coming up in `days` days, under way, or over with the record still incomplete; each with every part
of the record and `next_step`. The anaesthetist's pre-anaesthesia clinic and the surgeon's list (`mine`: the
operations the caller operates or anaesthetizes). With `admission_id`: every operation of that stay, complete or
not (the ward opens the post-operative plan from it). Refresh on `ot.clinical.updated` and `ot.booking.updated`.

GET /ot/bookings/{booking_id}/surgical-r.summary: The surgical record of an operation
GET /ot/bookings/{booking_id}/surgical-r.description:
Every part in order with where it stands (`parts`) and `next_step`: the pre-operative note, the pre-anaesthesia
assessments, the pauses of the checklist, the anaesthesia record with its chart (and `chart_gaps`), the operative
note and post-operative plan, recovery, the adverse events and the corrections. Drafts list what signing still
needs (`missing`). Reading it is logged as a patient-data access.

**Required permission:** `ot.clinical.view`
